verses.text: So I, a prisoner for the Lord, beg you to live a life worthy of the calling you have received.
Be humble and gentle in every way. Be patient, and put up with one another in love.
Try hard to keep the unity of the Spirit, joined together by peace.
There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope.
There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
and one God and Father of all. He is over all, through all, and in all.
But each one of us has been given grace, as Christ chose to give it.
That is why the Scripture says, "When he went up on high, he led captives with him, and gave gifts to people."
What does "he went up" mean? It means he also first came down to the lower parts of the earth.
The one who came down is the same one who went up far above all the heavens, so that he could fill everything.
He gave some people to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be preachers of the Good News, and some to be pastors and teachers.
Their task is to prepare God's people for works of service, so that the body of Christ is built up.
This goes on until we all come to unity in the faith and in knowing the Son of God. Then we will be mature, and reach the full measure of Christ.
Then we will no longer be like children, thrown back and forth by every wind of teaching. We will not be fooled by people's tricks and clever lies.
Instead, we will speak the truth in love. We will grow up in every way into Christ, who is the head.
From him the whole body is joined and held together by every part. As each part does its work, the body grows and builds itself up in love.
So I tell you this, and I insist on it in the Lord. You must no longer live like the Gentiles, whose thinking is empty.
Their understanding is darkened. They are cut off from the life of God, because they do not know him and their hearts are hard.
They have lost all feeling. They have given themselves over to wild living. They are greedy to do every kind of impure thing.
But that is not the way you learnt about Christ.
You heard about him and were taught in him, and the truth is in Jesus.
You were taught to put off your old self and your old way of life. The old self is ruined by its lying desires.
You were taught to be made new in the attitude of your minds,
and to put on the new self. It is created to be like God, truly right and holy.
So stop telling lies. Each of you must speak the truth to your neighbour, because we all belong to one body.
"When you are angry, do not sin." Do not let the sun go down while you are still angry,
and do not give the devil a chance.
Anyone who has been stealing must stop. Instead, he must work, doing something useful with his own hands. Then he will have something to share with those in need.
Do not let any bad talk come out of your mouths. Only say what helps build others up, as they need it. Then your words will do good to those who hear.
Do not make the Holy Spirit of God sad. He is the seal that marks you for the day you will be set free.
Get rid of all bitterness, rage, anger, shouting and evil talk, along with every kind of spite.
Be kind to one another and tender-hearted. Forgive each other, just as God forgave you in Christ.
